title: Login with valid credentials
objective: To verify if the user is able to login with valid credentials.
preconditions: The user is registered and has valid login credentials. The login page is accessible.
expected_result: The user is successfully logged in and redirected to the dashboard.

title: Login with invalid credentials
objective: To verify if the system prevents login with invalid credentials.
preconditions: The user is on the login page.
expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials.

title: Password reset link
objective: To verify if the password reset link is working correctly.
preconditions: The user is on the login page and has a registered email.
expected_result: A password reset link is sent to the registered email.

title: Navigation menu visibility
objective: To verify if the navigation menu is visible on the dashboard.
preconditions: The user is logged in and on the dashboard page.
steps: Look for the navigation menu on the dashboard
expected_result: The navigation menu is visible on the dashboard.

title: Logout functionality
objective: To verify if the logout functionality is working correctly.
preconditions: The user is logged in.
expected_result: The user is logged out and redirected to the login page.

title: Profile picture upload
objective: To verify if the user can upload a profile picture.
preconditions: The user is logged in and on the profile settings page.
steps: Select a picture from the device
expected_result: The selected picture is uploaded and displayed as the profile picture.

title: Profile picture file size limit
objective: To verify if the system restricts the file size of the profile picture.
preconditions: The user is logged in and on the profile settings page.
steps: Select a picture with size more than the limit
expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the file size limit.

title: Password strength indicator
objective: To verify if the password strength indicator is working correctly.
preconditions: The user is on the 'Change Password' page.
steps: Enter a password in the 'New Password' field
expected_result: The password strength indicator displays the strength of the entered password.

title: Search functionality
objective: To verify if the search functionality is working correctly.
preconditions: The user is logged in and on a page with a search bar.
steps: Enter a search term in the search bar
expected_result: The search results related to the search term are displayed.

title: Input field character limit
objective: To verify if the system restricts the number of characters in an input field.
preconditions: The user is on a page with an input field.
steps: Enter characters in the input field more than the limit
expected_result: The system restricts input after reaching the character limit.

title: Pagination functionality
objective: To verify if the pagination functionality is working correctly.
preconditions: The user is on a page with a list of items and pagination.
expected_result: The page displays the items corresponding to the clicked page number.

title: Data sorting functionality
objective: To verify if the data sorting functionality is working correctly.
preconditions: The user is on a page with sortable data.
expected_result: The data is sorted based on the clicked column header.

title: Data filtering functionality
objective: To verify if the data filtering functionality is working correctly.
preconditions: The user is on a page with filterable data.
expected_result: The data is filtered based on the selected filter option.

title: Form submission with all fields filled
objective: To verify if the form can be submitted with all fields filled.
preconditions: The user is on a form page.
steps: Fill all the fields in the form
expected_result: The form is submitted successfully.

title: Form submission with mandatory fields empty
objective: To verify if the system prevents form submission with mandatory fields empty.
preconditions: The user is on a form page.
expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the mandatory fields.

title: Date picker functionality
objective: To verify if the date picker functionality is working correctly.
preconditions: The user is on a page with a date picker field.
steps: Click on the date picker field
expected_result: The selected date is displayed in the date picker field.

title: Checkbox selection
objective: To verify if the checkbox can be selected and deselected.
preconditions: The user is on a page with a checkbox.
expected_result: The checkbox is selected or deselected based on its previous state.

title: Radio button selection
objective: To verify if the radio button can be selected.
preconditions: The user is on a page with radio buttons.
expected_result: The clicked radio button is selected.

title: Dropdown selection
objective: To verify if an option can be selected from a dropdown.
preconditions: The user is on a page with a dropdown.
expected_result: The selected option is displayed as the selected option in the dropdown.

title: URL redirection
objective: To verify if the URL redirects to the correct page.
preconditions: The user is on a page with a hyperlink.
expected_result: The user is redirected to the correct page.

title: Tooltip visibility
objective: To verify if the tooltip is visible on hovering over an element.
preconditions: The user is on a page with an element having a tooltip.
expected_result: The tooltip is visible.

title: Error message visibility
objective: To verify if the error message is visible on form validation failure.
preconditions: The user is on a form page.
steps: Submit the form with invalid data
expected_result: The error message is visible.

title: Success message visibility
objective: To verify if the success message is visible on successful form submission.
preconditions: The user is on a form page.
steps: Submit the form with valid data
expected_result: The success message is visible.

title: Input field data retention
objective: To verify if the data in the input field is retained after page refresh.
preconditions: The user is on a form page and has entered data in an input field.
expected_result: The data in the input field is retained.

title: Input field data clearance
objective: To verify if the data in the input field is cleared on clicking the 'Clear' button.
preconditions: The user is on a form page and has entered data in an input field.
expected_result: The data in the input field is cleared.

title: Verify Login Functionality
objective: To ensure that the login functionality is working as expected.
preconditions: The user must have a valid username and password. The login page should be accessible.
expected_result: The user should be successfully logged in and redirected to the home page.

title: Test Password Encryption
objective: To ensure that the user's password is properly encrypted.
preconditions: The user must have a valid account. The login page should be accessible.
steps: Inspect the network traffic for the login request.
expected_result: The password in the network request should be encrypted.

title: Check UI Responsiveness on Mobile
objective: To ensure that the application's UI is responsive on mobile devices.
preconditions: The application should be accessible on a mobile device.
steps: Open the application on a mobile device.
Check the responsiveness of the UI.
expected_result: The application's UI should be responsive and properly scaled on the mobile device.

title: Test Input Field Boundary
objective: To test the maximum character limit of an input field.
preconditions: The application should be accessible. The input field should be visible.
steps: Navigate to the page with the input field.
Enter characters into the input field until the limit is reached.
expected_result: No more characters should be able to be entered once the limit is reached.

title: Verify Error Message Display
objective: To ensure that the appropriate error message is displayed when an invalid username or password is entered.
preconditions: The user must have a valid account. The login page should be accessible.
steps: Enter an invalid username or password.
expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating that the username or password is incorrect.

title: Test Logout Functionality
objective: To ensure that the logout functionality is working as expected.
preconditions: The user must be logged in. The logout button should be visible.
steps: Confirm the logout action if prompted.
Check if the user is logged out.
expected_result: The user should be successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.

title: Check Session Timeout
objective: To ensure that the user's session expires after a period of inactivity.
preconditions: The user must be logged in. The application should be idle for the session timeout duration.
steps: Leave the application idle for the session timeout duration.
Try to navigate to a different page.
expected_result: The user should be logged out and redirected to the login page.

title: Test Navigation Menu
objective: To ensure that the navigation menu is functioning correctly.
preconditions: The user must be logged in. The navigation menu should be visible.
steps: Click on each item in the navigation menu.
Check if the user is redirected to the correct page.
expected_result: The user should be redirected to the correct page when an item in the navigation menu is clicked.

title: Check Password Complexity Requirements
objective: To ensure that the password complexity requirements are enforced.
preconditions: The user must be on the change password page.
steps: Enter a password that does not meet the complexity requirements.
expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating that the password does not meet the complexity requirements.

title: Test Form Submission
objective: To ensure that form data is correctly submitted.
preconditions: The user must be on a form page. The form should be filled out.
steps: Check if the form data is correctly submitted.
expected_result: The form data should be correctly submitted and the user should be redirected to the appropriate page.

title: Verify Data Encryption
objective: To ensure that sensitive data is properly encrypted.
preconditions: The user must be logged in. Sensitive data should be submitted.
steps: Inspect the network traffic for the data submission request.
expected_result: The sensitive data in the network request should be encrypted.

title: Check UI Responsiveness on Tablet
objective: To ensure that the application's UI is responsive on tablet devices.
preconditions: The application should be accessible on a tablet device.
steps: Open the application on a tablet device.
Check the responsiveness of the UI.
expected_result: The application's UI should be responsive and properly scaled on the tablet device.

title: Test Dropdown Field Boundary
objective: To test the maximum selection limit of a dropdown field.
preconditions: The application should be accessible. The dropdown field should be visible.
steps: Navigate to the page with the dropdown field.
Select options in the dropdown field until the limit is reached.
expected_result: No more options should be able to be selected once the limit is reached.

title: Verify Success Message Display
objective: To ensure that the appropriate success message is displayed when a form is successfully submitted.
preconditions: The user must be on a form page. The form should be filled out.
expected_result: A success message should be displayed indicating that the form was successfully submitted.

title: Test Page Refresh
objective: To ensure that the page refresh functionality is working as expected.
preconditions: The user must be on a page. The page should be loaded.
steps: Check if the page is correctly reloaded.
expected_result: The page should be correctly reloaded.

title: Check Cookie Security
objective: To ensure that cookies are securely handled.
preconditions: The user must be logged in. Cookies should be set.
steps: Inspect the cookies set by the application.
Check if the cookies are secure and HttpOnly.
expected_result: The cookies set by the application should be secure and HttpOnly.

title: Test Pagination Functionality
objective: To ensure that the pagination functionality is working as expected.
preconditions: The user must be on a page with pagination. There should be multiple pages of content.
steps: Check if the correct page of content is displayed.
expected_result: The correct page of content should be displayed when a page number is clicked.

title: Check Username Uniqueness
objective: To ensure that usernames are unique.
preconditions: The user must be on the registration page.
steps: Enter a username that is already taken.
expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating that the username is already taken.

title: Test Search Functionality
objective: To ensure that the search functionality is working as expected.
preconditions: The user must be on a page with a search bar. There should be content to search.
expected_result: The search results should correctly reflect the search term.

title: Verify Data Integrity
objective: To ensure that data is not corrupted during transmission.
preconditions: The user must be logged in. Data should be transmitted.
expected_result: The transmitted data should not be corrupted.

title: Check UI Consistency
objective: To ensure that the application's UI is consistent across different pages.
preconditions: The application should be accessible.
steps: Check the consistency of the UI.
expected_result: The application's UI should be consistent across different pages.

title: Test Checkbox Field Boundary
objective: To test the maximum selection limit of a checkbox field.
preconditions: The application should be accessible. The checkbox field should be visible.
steps: Navigate to the page with the checkbox field.
Select options in the checkbox field until the limit is reached.
expected_result: No more options should be able to be selected once the limit is reached.

title: Verify Tooltip Display
objective: To ensure that tooltips are correctly displayed when hovering over an element.
preconditions: The user must be on a page with an element that has a tooltip.
steps: Check if the tooltip is displayed.
expected_result: The tooltip should be displayed when hovering over the element.

title: Test Back Button
objective: To ensure that the back button functionality is working as expected.
preconditions: The user must be on a page. The user should have navigated to the page from another page.
steps: Check if the user is redirected to the previous page.
expected_result: The user should be redirected to the previous page.

title: Verify Login Functionality
objective: To ensure that the user is able to log in successfully using valid credentials.
preconditions: The user must have a valid username and password. The login page of the application is accessible.
expected_result: The user should be successfully logged in and redirected to the home page.

title: Check Error Message for Invalid Login
objective: To verify that the application displays an appropriate error message when invalid credentials are used.
preconditions: The user is on the login page of the application.
steps: Enter an invalid username and password
expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating that the login attempt was unsuccessful.

title: Test Password Encryption
objective: To ensure that user passwords are stored securely and not in plain text.
preconditions: The user has a registered account with a password.
steps: Check the stored password for the user
expected_result: The password should be stored as an encrypted hash, not in plain text.

title: Verify Logout Functionality
objective: To ensure that the user is able to log out successfully.
preconditions: The user is logged into the application.
expected_result: The user should be successfully logged out and redirected to the login page.

title: Check Session Timeout
objective: To verify that the application logs out the user after a period of inactivity.
preconditions: The user is logged into the application.
steps: Leave the application idle for the specified timeout period
expected_result: The user should be automatically logged out after the timeout period.

title: Test Password Reset Functionality
objective: To ensure that the user is able to reset their password successfully.
preconditions: The user has a registered account and has access to the associated email address.
steps: Click on the reset password link in the received email
Enter a new password and confirm it
expected_result: The user should be able to reset their password and log in with the new password.

title: Verify Email Validation
objective: To ensure that the application validates email addresses correctly during registration.
preconditions: The user is on the registration page of the application.
steps: Attempt to submit the registration form
expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating that the email address is invalid.

title: Check Username Uniqueness
objective: To verify that the application does not allow the creation of multiple accounts with the same username.
preconditions: The user is on the registration page of the application. An account with a specific username already exists.
steps: Attempt to submit the registration form
expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating that the username is already taken.

title: Test Profile Picture Upload
objective: To ensure that the user is able to upload a profile picture successfully.
preconditions: The user is logged into the application and is on their profile page.
steps: Click on the 'upload profile picture' button
expected_result: The profile picture should be updated with the uploaded image.

title: Verify Data Persistence
objective: To ensure that user data is saved and persists across sessions.
preconditions: The user is logged into the application and has made changes to their profile.
steps: Log back in and navigate to the profile page
expected_result: The changes made to the profile should still be present.
